stance_basis: testified in support of Airport Spur addition to Milwaukee County Freeway System Master Plan and submitted statement confirming no park interference
summary: R. W. Brannan, Milwaukee County Transportation Director, appeared at the March 25, 1969 public hearing and testified in favor of the Airport Spur, noting that the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission had recommended its addition to the County Freeway System Master Plan already approved by the County Board. He also submitted a supporting statement from the Park Commission confirming no conflict with park development. He is additionally identified as a co-signer (with H. B. Wildschut) of Statement C, the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission letter endorsing Alternate #5 as the least disruptive option with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
complaint_summary: Brannan testified that the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission recommended adding the Airport Spur to the Milwaukee County Freeway System Master Plan already approved by the County Board, and submitted a Park Commission statement confirming the corridor does not interfere with any present or proposed park development.
summary_quote: Stated that Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission has recommended the addition of the Airport Spur connection to its Milwaukee County Freeway System Master Plan which the Milwaukee County Board has already approved.
